correctness.rationale: The count uses substitutions of the full maximal-ideal-power quotient, not coordinatewise truncation. Any tuple from the maximal ideal defines a map; invertibility on the tangent space gives invertibility on all graded pieces. For an idempotent, choose coordinates u,w along the tangent image and kernel. The substitution u↦e(u), w↦w−e(w) is tangent-identity and intertwines the coordinate projection with e. Thus each image is a copy of the r-generator quotient and its literal tangent plane is well-defined. For a fixed plane U choose a coordinate retraction P onto its copy B0. On each candidate image B, P|B has invertible tangent map between equally sized truncated symmetric algebras, hence is an isomorphism. Its inverse picks unique lifts u_i+k_i with k_i in ker(P)∩m²; conversely every such tuple defines a section of P and the resulting image is a retract. This counts q^{r(H_d(n)−H_d(r))} per plane. Once B=B0 by conjugation, a retraction fixes its generators and freely assigns the n−r remaining generators to m∩B0, giving the stated fiber. The monomial count and Gaussian factor give the cardinality and total, including the augmentation and identity boundaries and d=2. Independent bounded replay: python3 /workspace/branches/independent_checks.py 4 enumerates all 1,024 substitutions for (n,d,q)=(2,3,2) with bitwise multiplication and groups literal image sets. It gives 12 eight-element images with fibers of four and one image each of sizes two and 64 with fibers of one. The frozen checker was inspected, not executed; this replay is finite corroboration.

The all-order formula quantifies how the higher jets change the number of placements and the prescribed-image multiplicity separately, across all characteristics.
